summary.answer: Hud_WZ frozen caller directly constructs this PC-named container without a local IsPC guard at its call site. Constructor calls StartAddingSticky then PreSetupMenuBattlenet, builds focusable/Battlenet children. Visible requires IsPC AND MenuBattlenetIsActive; Invisible predicate always true. With proven IsPC=false its own Visible state is excluded, but unconditional constructor/setup calls are not thereby absent. Menu-open callback conditionally calls SetupPositionOverrideForWZEndGame only on first event; callback is registered on the parent menu. It saves __on_close_removeOverrides to remove that callback, then registers self.__onClose via CallOriginalSecond; because __onClose is outside frozen span, do not claim removal actually executes on close. Optional postload then StopAddingSticky before returning self. Exact platform, native display, hook/lifetime and PC provider behavior remain conditional; no unrelated platform service internals authored.
